title: Zero-cost public hosting and verified launch entrypoints
objective: Publish the already-qualified Deskal static website through a zero-cost GitHub Pages deployment and connect the repository and website to verified public launch entrypoints without adding Deskal runtime authority, mandatory paid infrastructure, telemetry, credentials, backend state, or custom DNS.

include: GitHub Pages deployment of the existing apps/web static export from GitHub Actions
least-privilege Pages workflow permissions with commit-pinned third-party or GitHub actions
project-page base-path and asset-path handling for the canonical TheHalfMoon/Deskal repository
post-deployment HTTPS smoke verification of the published site and key static assets
public website links to the canonical GitHub repository, documentation, and GitHub Releases surface only
README integration that points users to the canonical hosted website and verified release surface
tests that prevent telemetry, analytics, forms, authentication, payment, hosted backend, secret, custom-domain, or unverified-download additions
exclude: changes to qdral compatibility CLI, daemon, npm packages, environment variables, OAuth scopes, source paths, storage paths, or MCP server name
changes to local runtime authority, MCP tool exposure, provider execution, approvals, trust, leases, policy, audit, revocation, browser actuation, or process authority
custom DNS or a custom domain
analytics, tracking, cookies, authentication, payments, forms, hosted APIs, databases, or server-side rendering
uploading release binaries to the website or introducing a release distribution path outside GitHub Releases
publishing or modifying a GitHub Release
mandatory paid infrastructure or secret-bearing deployment credentials

authority_delta.filesystem: Repository website source, tests, documentation, and GitHub Pages workflow only; no Deskal runtime filesystem authority changes.
authority_delta.network: GitHub Actions may publish the static site to GitHub Pages and perform bounded HTTPS smoke checks against the Pages URL; Deskal runtime network authority is unchanged.
authority_delta.secrets: No repository or environment secret is required. GitHub Pages deployment may use GitHub-provided short-lived OIDC and Pages tokens scoped only to the workflow.

invariants: Deskal remains local-first and the hosted website is documentation and static marketing only
the website cannot become a control plane, approval surface, runtime transport, relay, or authority broker
no analytics, telemetry, tracking, cookies, forms, authentication, payments, hosted API, or database is introduced
no custom domain or DNS change is authorized
all download CTAs point only to the canonical GitHub Releases surface and do not claim an unpublished version
GitHub Pages workflow permissions remain limited to contents read, pages write, and id-token write where required
deployment actions are commit-pinned and no deployment secret is added
runtime and MCP authority remain unchanged outside this grain's intended website and repository integration surface

acceptance.claim: The canonical Deskal static export is published successfully through GitHub Pages at the repository project-site URL over HTTPS, with the home page and required static assets returning successful responses after deployment.

The Pages workflow uses least privilege, commit-pinned actions, no repository secret, no custom domain, and no backend service; project-page base-path handling works in both CI build output and the deployed site.
The website and README expose canonical repository, documentation, and GitHub Releases entrypoints only, with no direct unverified artifact URL and no claim that an unpublished release exists.
Automated tests and source scans prove the hosted surface has no analytics, telemetry, tracking, cookies, forms, authentication, payments, hosted API, database, or runtime-control dependency.
All existing Rust, Node, governance, supply-chain, release qualification, relay-container, and web gates remain green with no runtime-source authority change.

Exact-head CI, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of exclusions, zero unresolved blocking review threads, normal merge, successful Pages deployment, and post-merge verification complete before canonical closeout.

successor_requirements.custom_domain: Any custom domain or DNS change requires a separately authorized successor.
successor_requirements.release_publish: Publishing or changing a release, installer, package registry, or artifact distribution path requires separately authorized successor work.
successor_requirements.dynamic_services: Any analytics, authentication, forms, payments, hosted API, database, telemetry, or server-side behavior requires separately authorized successor work.

done_when: The zero-cost GitHub Pages site is deployed and HTTPS-smoke-verified from the canonical repository, public launch entrypoints are evidence-bounded and point only to canonical repository/docs/releases surfaces, all existing CI remains green, no runtime authority changes, and post-merge verification is complete.

canonical_evidence.jev: PASSED: TypeSafe Jev exact-head review covered 24/24 hunks with zero blocking findings; maximum blocker probability 0.15.
canonical_evidence.ocr: PASSED: Alibaba Open Code Review exact-range delegation covered 8 changed files with 7 reviewable and README.md manually reviewed as the sole exclusion; zero findings.
canonical_evidence.pages: PASSED: GitHub Pages build, deploy, and HTTPS verification completed successfully on run 37498630641 with build_type=workflow, HTTPS enforced, no CNAME, and no deployment secret.
canonical_evidence.authority_boundary: Static GitHub Pages hosting and repository launch integration only. No Deskal runtime or MCP authority change, custom domain, backend, analytics, telemetry, authentication, payments, secrets, release publication, installer change, or alternate artifact distribution.
